title: Pipedrive API Review [August 2026]: Features & Limits
snippet:
**Pipedrive's API** is a mature REST surface with two active versions (v1 and v2), [OAuth 2.0 support](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Oauth), published [OpenAPI 3 specs](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1), official SDKs for Node.js and PHP, full [webhook support](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/guide-for-webhooks-v2), and API access on every plan, including the entry-level Lite tier.
The [developer hub](https://developers.pipedrive.com/) is public, the changelog announces breaking changes with lead time, and a free sandbox account lets you build without touching production data.

**Pipedrive** includes API access on every paid plan. There are no per-call charges, no separate API tier, and no enterprise-only gating. The effective cost of API access is the plan subscription itself.
The [plan tiers](https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/how-does-pricing-work-in-pipedrive) (per seat, per month):

title: Pipedrive API review: the daily token budget explained
snippet:
The Pipedrive API is free in the sense that matters: no per-call charge, no credit balance, API access on every paid seat. What Pipedrive meters instead is complexity, through a daily token budget, and that model is unusual enough to be worth understanding before you write anything.
Every endpoint has a token cost. Reading one record costs 2 tokens, reading a list costs 20, updating a record costs 10, and searching costs 40. Your account gets a daily allowance calculated as 30,000 base tokens times a plan multiplier times your seat count, shared across everyone on the account. Spend it and every request returns 429 until midnight in Pipedrive's server timezone.

Pipedrive API pricing is seat pricing. There is no API line item, no credit pack and no metering in dollars, but the plan you buy multiplies your daily token budget, so the tier does change what the API can do.

Prices are the annual rate, which Pipedrive advertises as saving up to 42% against monthly. There is a 14-day trial with no card and no free tier after it. The multiplier is the part worth modeling: moving from Lite to Premium is four times the price and five times the token budget, so if the API is what you are buying, the expensive plan is cheaper per token.
